raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Chose option B by overextending the role of somatic support cells in gonads; the standard and correct mechanism by which a somatic cell mutation harms an organism is tumor formation in tissues (option C). Somatic mutations are not typically about affecting gamete formation (a germline process) and are not passed to offspring. The Planner misapplied biology fundamentals and selected a non-canonical outcome.
